subject: Aurora Payments — procurement & PO timeline (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@aurorapayments.com>, Sanjay Kapoor <sanjay.kapoor@aurorapayments.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@aurorapayments.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Aurora Payments — procurement & PO timeline (post-call recap)

Hi Priya / Sanjay —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we can keep procurement moving: 

1) Decision criteria / value props we discussed
- Improve inference latency for customer-facing features (90th pctl target < 200ms)
- ~40% reduction in per-token inference cost vs current setup with batching and KV caching
- Predictable capacity for peak periods (Black Friday-like spikes)

2) Stakeholder mapping (confirming on the call)
- Economic buyer: Anil Desai, CFO (you mentioned)
- Security / IT reviewer: Rashmi Menon
- Procurement & vendor onboarding: procurement@aurorapayments.com

3) Procurement asks from Aurora we should confirm
- Vendor onboarding form + W-9 / tax info
- Standard contract redlines and SLA confirmation
- PO issuance & invoicing cadence / net terms (Net 30 by default)

4) Proposed timeline
- We can provide SOW + pricing and vendor forms by EOD tomorrow (attached: SOW draft, pricing spreadsheet)
- Recommended: 30-minute procurement review call next week to run through the onboarding checklist and any contract questions

Next steps for us (Marissa / Michael):
- Share SOW + pricing + vendor onboarding checklist (attached) — ACTION: Marissa (today)
- Share security package (SOC 2 report + pen test summary) link for Rashmi — ACTION: Michael (today)

Priya / Sanjay — can you confirm: 1) the procurement contact (if different from procurement@aurorapayments.com), 2) PO approval timeline (are you targeting by end of Nov / first week of Dec?), and 3) preferred net terms?

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Redwood-SOW-draft-20261110.pdf, Redwood-pricing-20261110.xlsx

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@aurorapayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Sanjay Kapoor <sanjay.kapoor@aurorapayments.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@aurorapayments.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aurora Payments — procurement & PO timeline (post-call recap)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments — reviewed quickly and looks good. A few answers / clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement contact: procurement@aurorapayments.com (same), but I will loop in our procurement lead, Elena Martinez, in the procurement call.
- Economic buyer: confirmed Anil Desai (CFO) — we'll need a short exec summary for him (~1 page) outlining expected ROI and cost comparisons.
- Security reviewer: Rashmi Menon (infosec). She will need SOC 2 Type II and our standard vendor risk assessment filled out.
- PO / timeline: goal is to have a PO issued by Dec 1 if procurement review goes smoothly. We may need the vendor onboarding form completed by next week to hit that date.
- Net terms: our legal typically targets Net 45 for new vendors, but we can work toward Net 30 if you have standard Net 30 pricing — would you be able to accept Net 45 initially while we aim to move to Net 30 after first invoice?

I'll attach the vendor onboarding PDF and the vendor registration questionnaire — please complete and return; procurement prefers the completed PDF rather than a link.

Happy to do the 30-min procurement call next Tue (Nov 17) at 10am PT — that works for me and Elena (I'll confirm).

Thanks,
Priya
Head of Product Partnerships
Aurora Payments
priya.rao@aurorapayments.com

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-form-aurora.pdf

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@aurorapayments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Procurement <procurement@aurorapayments.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aurora Payments — procurement & PO timeline (post-call recap)

Thanks Priya — and great to meet you on the call. Quick notes from the Redwood side: 

- We can absolutely provide SOC 2 Type II and our latest penetration test report; I'll share the security package link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3xExampleSecurityPackage (we'll also export PDFs if procurement prefers attachments).
- On net terms: we normally operate Net 30; we're open to Net 45 for the first invoice while contracts are finalized. Should be fine on our side.
- On invoicing: Redwood sends monthly invoices; we can add Aurora's PO number and billing contact to the invoice header. Laura (cc'd) handles billing setup and vendor registration on our side.

Proposed next step: 30-min procurement/IT sync Tue Nov 17 10:00am PT. I can join and walk through SOW + billing fields procurement asks for.

I'll also attach a short exec summary (one-pager) that Marissa can share with Anil.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood-security-summary-20261112.pdf, Redwood-exec-summary-aurora-20261112.pdf

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@aurorapayments.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@aurorapayments.com>, Procurement <procurement@aurorapayments.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aurora Payments — procurement & PO timeline (post-call recap)

Thanks Michael / Marissa — confirmed for Tue Nov 17 10:00am PT — sending calendar invite now (Elena looped).

Quick note on terms: procurement is fine to start with Net 45 for the first invoice; they will prioritize the PO and expect to issue it by Dec 1 pending the procurement call. Please complete and return the vendor onboarding form before the call so procurement can pre-populate fields.

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Priya
